sourceChecks.text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を周辺の系図・名簿と照合した。
